message: 不都合な真実

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sacchin, what did you just say!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I said it's exams~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uhh... I didn't hear you. How about you, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Right after 'I said,' I suddenly felt a wave of nausea, and then I heard 'it's exams~'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What a coincidence. Exact same thing happened to me」

name: Azel
message: 「Exams」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whoa, you two turned completely pale~」

name: Eddie
message: 「Ooh, burned out before the fight even starts. Hey, Azel-chan, shouldn't you take a picture?」

name: Azel
message: 「Shut up」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You totally snapped one already~ Show me later~」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah!? What on earth just happened to me!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You turned completely pale~」
God! Please grant me the courage to face reality!

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin, when do exams start? Next month or so, right?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Next week~」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Next week......」
Being a scholarship student is the only reason I can attend this academy--what does tomorrow hold for me!?

name: Synn
message: 「Exams, huh......」

name: Misa
message: 「Exams, indeed......」

name: Ria
message: 「Merciless, aren't they\s02」

name: Azel
message: 「A rare sight」

name: Synn
message: 「This is the first time I've ever faced a test feeling like this...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You've got it good... Synn, you're great at cramming overnight」

name: Synn
message: 「Look, up until now, I only crammed the night before after doing the bare minimum of daily prep and review... This time, I haven't done any of that groundwork at all」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I even quit cram school for Student Council work... If my grades drop now, I'll look like an idiot! This is my big chance with Sakura-kun about to fall from first place!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's with you two, talking like spoiled brats! I'm on the verge of dropping from average straight into failing!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're the only one operating on such a low level」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Fufufu. You're all looking so gloomy. As for me, I'm already completely ready」

name: Everyone
message: 「Whaaaat!?」

name: Synn
message: 「When did you find the time to study!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And here I thought Lolo-chan looked like the most hopeless one of us!」

name: Misa
message: 「I feel betrayed」

name: Paqy
message: 「I've got a feeling this is gonna end with a terrible punchline」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's because you all flail around in a panic. From the very beginning--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aaah, you don't need to say another word」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, as expected of you, Senpai. Remaining so calm even in a situation like this」
'Sorry. I'm a third-year, so I don't have any tests'

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai, please stop mouthing words without making a sound」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I feel like we just missed hearing something super important, right」

name: Ria
message: 「...I didn't say anything, so it's fine」

name: Lolotte
message: 「At times like these, all of us Student Council officers should go down in a blaze of glory with grace」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But whether I can keep my scholarship is riding on this!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's quite a massive ambition to have in this situation」

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Synn's livelihood is on the line here. And mine along with it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He's the Student Council President, so won't he be fine?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right! I'm the Student Council President, so my status as a scholarship student is guaranteed!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. You can't just make up rules on your own」

name: Ria
message: 「If that were true, I think I would have been a scholarship student last year, wouldn't I?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that right... Yeah, you're right...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Senpai, at least let him dream for a little while」

name: Ria
message: 「Even if you escape reality, the tests are still coming」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now, now everyone, we're officers of the Student Council, so we can work something out」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You have a brilliant idea!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Fortunately, the president, vice president, treasurer, and secretary are all allies. We just need to make a rule that Student Council officers automatically get full marks on tests」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh! Why didn't I think of that! Lolo-chan, you're a genius!」

name: Misa
message: 「That's wrong! But, but」

name: Misa
message: 「So this is how people fall into corruption...」

name: Azel
message: 「What is a scholarship student」

name: Ria
message: 「It refers to a student with top grades and good conduct who is granted privileges like tuition exemption and stipends」
Azel stared intently at me.

name: Synn
message: 「Those eyes are definitely doubting me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, since it's Synn, that can't be helped」

name: Misa
message: 「It is Sakura-kun, after all」

name: Lolotte
message: 「He is the President, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「That hurts...」

name: Azel
message: 「...I'm not doubting you」

name: Azel
message: 「I just thought it didn't suit you」
I wonder if Pasta's around?

name: Pasta
message: 「Hey! Stop just drinking water over there, nya!」
Same as always.

name: Pasta
message: 「You lovey-dovey couple over there! This isn't a love hotel, nya! Hurry up and order, eat, and do the rest in the corner of the gym storage room or something, nya!」
Hmm. Terrible attitude as usual.
Could it be... Miss Helena knew Pasta was a Demon General all along?
And that's why she didn't fire her, letting her roam free to figure out her intentions?
No way... right?
Judging from how we talked when we fought, it didn't seem like she was completely unwilling to listen, so I hope she'll open up and talk to me someday, though.

name: Pasta
message: 「I'm not listening to your protests, nya! Go wash your face in boiling water and start over, nya!」
Willing to listen... I sure hope she is...

name: Pasta
message: 「Nooo, not the Sheer-Cliff Agony Chili Pepper Meta Special, nyaaaaa!」
Seeing her get punished like that, she doesn't look like a Demon General at all...
